baseline_models.focus_anchor: In حتى أتىٰنا اليقين, اليقين is the grammatical subject of أتىٰ and نا is what it reaches.
baseline_models.mechanism: The coming branch of ء ت ي and the settled-knowledge branch of ي ق ن make certainty an incoming event. حتى gives that event a temporal threshold, so closure comes to the speakers rather than merely developing inside them.

activation_trace.role: Literal coming and arrival makes certainty the active arriver and the speakers its reached endpoint.
Settled knowledge and removal of doubt supplies the closure carried by the arriving subject.

changed_reading.after: Certainty itself came to us and closed the preceding interval of doubt.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verb أتىٰنا can activate the ء ت ي branch in which death, calamity, or ruin overtakes someone, while اليقين still names doubt-ending closure.
baseline_models.mechanism: Arrival and destruction coexist within the focus inventory. On this branch, the event that removes doubt does so by overtaking the speakers as a terminal calamity, not by offering another proposition for reflection.

activation_trace.role: Being overtaken by death, calamity, or ruin gives the arrival a destructive terminal force.
Removal of doubt makes the overtaking event epistemically final as well as destructive.

changed_reading.before: An uncertain matter finally became clear.
changed_reading.after: A terminal calamity overtook us as the event that made continued denial impossible.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: حتى and أتىٰنا can be read through the ء ت ي images of a directed watercourse and the far limit of a traveled road.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus-only branches permit a processual rather than punctiliar arrival: a course is directed toward a basin or reaches its far boundary, and settled certainty is what occupies that terminal point.

activation_trace.role: A watercourse whose flow is cleared or directed supplies a continuous route toward the speakers.
The traveled road and far limit turns حتى into the boundary reached by the course.
Settled knowledge names the terminal state at which the course can proceed no farther.

changed_reading.before: Certainty appeared at a late moment.
changed_reading.after: A continuing course reached its far boundary in the arrival of irreversible certainty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The threatened meeting with fire and its leaving no remainder precede the focus, while failed benefit and failed intercessory joining follow it immediately. This bracket strengthens the focus branch in which ruin overtakes: the certainty that comes is an irreversible harmful event after which remedial social attachment no longer works.

activation_trace.role: The literal image of ruin overtaking someone makes the focus arrival capable of naming terminal calamity.
Doubt-ending knowledge explains why the overtaking event also ends epistemic refusal.
Literal contact with fire and its heat supplies the harmful event toward which the threat moves.
The image of a remainder, under explicit negation, makes the threatened endpoint exhaustive.
Benefit as the opposite of harm is negated immediately after the arrival, marking loss of remedy.
An intercessor literally joining another is rendered ineffective, closing the last relational escape.

structural_cues: The fire description in 74:26-29 precedes the confession, and 74:48 begins with a consequence-marking فما immediately after the focus.
حتى terminates the repeated first-person confession at the arrival event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fire-contact, no remainder, ruin-overtaking, and failed benefit or joining; I infer that these make the arrival itself the irreversible calamity. A live alternative is that اليقين names knowledge alone and the harmful consequences merely surround it.

changed_reading.before: Certainty finally informed the speakers that the threat was real.
changed_reading.after: The threatened ruin itself arrived and, by overtaking them, became the certainty after which no remedy could benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 74:31, a test leads people who were given the Book to become certain and not doubt; in 74:47 the participant structure reverses, because certainty itself comes to the confessors. The shared focus roots therefore distinguish timely certainty mediated by something received from terminal certainty that arrives as an independent agent.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arrival makes certainty, rather than a document or person, the subject that reaches the speakers.
Settled knowledge supplies the closure whose timing is being contrasted.
Testing metal or a person supplies an earlier proving process capable of yielding certainty.
Becoming settled in knowledge provides the same-surah instance of certainty reached during the test.
Granting and giving marks people as recipients of mediated material before their certainty forms.
Agitated doubt supplies the explicitly removed alternative to settled certainty.

structural_cues: 74:31 and 74:47 repeat both focus roots but reverse their grammatical deployment: recipients are given something there, while certainty is the arriving subject here.
The earlier certainty occurs inside a test-and-response scene; the focus certainty follows a four-clause retrospective confession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, being given the Book, becoming certain, absence of doubt, and the later arrival; I infer two opportunities and timings of closure, with mediated certainty still actionable and terminal certainty no longer so. The alternative is simple root repetition without a designed temporal contrast.

changed_reading.before: The verse says only that certainty eventually arrived.
changed_reading.after: This is the delayed counterpart to an earlier, mediated certainty: what could settle through a received test now comes independently at the terminal boundary.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sworn dawn both comes in the morning and uncovers what was veiled. Those images map onto the focus roots without replacing them: certainty arrives like a disclosure event, making what was resistible in darkness unavoidably visible.

activation_trace.role: Literal arrival provides the temporal motion that the coming of morning sharpens.
Removal of doubt functions as the epistemic analogue of newly unavoidable visibility.
Coming in the morning supplies a recurring temporal arrival that models certainty's onset.
Uncovering and removing a veil makes the arrival a disclosure rather than mere accumulation of evidence.

structural_cues: The focus follows the oath sequence of night retreating and dawn unveiling in 74:32-35.
Both scenes are threshold constructions: إذا marks dawn's onset and حتى marks certainty's terminal onset.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies morning-coming, unveiling, arrival, and doubt-removal; I infer a dawn-like mapping in which temporal onset causes visibility. The live alternative is that the dawn oath intensifies the warning generally without specifying how certainty arrives.

changed_reading.before: Certainty is a conclusion reached after enough time.
changed_reading.after: Certainty arrives as an unveiling threshold, like morning making a previously coverable reality impossible not to see.

context_deltas.mechanism: The question asks what made them penetrate a road into Saqar, the answers repeat a temporally sustained كنا frame, and one answer depicts wading. Together these activate the focus's watercourse and traveled-road branches: the confessed habits are not isolated causes but a maintained channel whose flow reaches its far limit in certainty.

activation_trace.role: A directed watercourse turns the arrival into the terminus of a continuous behavioral flow.
A traveled road and its far limit supplies the spatial endpoint marked by حتى.
Settled knowledge is the terminal condition reached when the route can no longer extend.
Occurrence and presence in time gives the repeated confession a sustained habitual frame.
Penetrating along a road spatializes the causal question as entry onto a route.
Entering and wading in water activates the focus inventory's directed-flow image.

structural_cues: 74:42 poses a path-entry question, 74:43-46 answer with four parallel first-person plural clauses, and 74:47 closes them with حتى.
The repeated نا/نـ perspective carries the same group from habitual action into أتانا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies road-penetration, wading, temporal repetition, and focus branches of channel and road; I infer that sustained conduct forms the current carrying the speakers to terminal certainty. The alternative is that the path and water images characterize separate clauses without composing one causal flow.

changed_reading.before: Certainty arrived after a list of wrong actions.
changed_reading.after: The repeated actions formed the route and current itself, which ran until irreversible certainty occupied its endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later demand imagines each person passively being given opened written sheets. The focus reverses that controlled delivery scene: no document is the delivered object, because certainty itself becomes the active arriver. This distinguishes negotiable proof in a demanded format from closure that comes on its own timing.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arrival gives certainty agency independent of a recipient's requested delivery terms.
Granting and giving keeps the alternate delivery valency live for contrast with the active focus verb.
Settled knowledge is what arrives when demands for a controllable proof-object have ceased to matter.
Passive granting places each person in the desired role of recipient and exposes the valency reversal.
A written sheet supplies the individualized, inspectable proof-object they demand to receive.
Opening and spreading makes the demanded sheets fully laid out rather than hidden.

structural_cues: 74:52 uses passive يؤتى with each person as prospective recipient; 74:47 uses active أتى with اليقين as subject and نا as goal.
The demand for personalized sheets occurs after the focus has already narrated certainty's arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies passive grant, opened written sheets, and active arrival; I infer that the demand seeks control over the form and timing of proof, which the focus arrival defeats. The alternative is a request for individualized revelation without any implication of evidentiary control.

changed_reading.before: The speakers lacked decisive proof until certainty eventually came.
changed_reading.after: What they would demand as personalized proof delivered on request instead arrives unbidden as certainty itself, beyond negotiation over format.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This legal-economic rendering is surprising because it activates the levy branch of ء ت ي rather than treating it as the ordinary gloss of أتىٰ. It remains anchored in the focus verb and is coherently supported by earning, collateral, debt/reckoning, a terminal road limit, and failed intercessory joining. Downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain mechanism: certainty arrives like maturity or foreclosure of an accrued claim, not as a lexical assertion that اليقين means debt collection.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أتىٰنا carries both an imposed-payment branch and a far-limit branch, allowing the arrival of اليقين to be modeled as a due claim reaching maturity.

activation_trace.role: An imposed levy or payment supplies the image of a claim that comes due to the speakers.
The road's far limit functions as the maturity point at which the claim is enforced.
Doubt-ending settlement makes the due event final rather than provisional.
Acquiring or earning supplies the accumulated basis of the obligation.
A document or collateral held for a right makes the self security for what it earned.
Financial debt activates the cross-domain image of a denied obligation coming due.
A representative joining the liable party fails after the modeled maturity event.

changed_reading.before: Certainty arrived as a late realization.
changed_reading.after: Certainty arrived like an accrued claim reaching maturity, fixing the collateral and ending the usefulness of third-party attachment.

strongest_changes: The repeated roots in 74:31 create two timings of certainty: mediated and still actionable there, independent and terminal in 74:47.
The path-entry question, repeated habits, and wading image turn the confession into a route or current whose endpoint is certainty.
Fire, no remainder, and failed benefit after the focus strengthen the reading of certainty as ruin that overtakes rather than information merely learned.
The demanded delivery of opened sheets reverses the focus grammar: proof is not handed over on demand; certainty itself arrives.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly changed the valency, timing, and material shape of أتىٰنا: granted mediation, dawn-like unveiling, directed flow, overtaking ruin, demanded document delivery, and even a contained foreclosure analogy all remained anchored to the two focus roots.
remaining_uncertainties: The identification of arriving certainty with the destructive event is strongly bracketed but still inferred; certainty may instead be knowledge immediately preceding that event.
The channel model depends on composing road and water branches across separate clauses rather than on an explicit statement that the habits cause the arrival.
The foreclosure outlier is mechanism-level only and should not be promoted into a lexical gloss.
